entities.summary: Henri Jacob Victor Sody was a Dutch agronomist and mammalogist born in The Hague. He died in Amsterdam in 1959. He is recognized for his contributions to the taxonomy of Indonesian mammals and some birds, as well as for his work regarding the Javan rhinoceros.
